case: PostgreSQL custom enum-array XLSX re-import through Gnumeric
contract: BookiE exports a custom enum[] containing literal NULL, empty text, Unicode, comma and quote labels, markup, a formula-shaped label, a backslash label and a SQL NULL element as a non-formula string cell.

The ignored PostgreSQL integration test is explicitly selected with --include-ignored and passes its native enum type, array_to_json and array_send checks; its SQL replay assertions also preserve a pre-existing sibling row.
Gnumeric re-saves the XLSX as ODS and back to XLSX; the full escaped array literal remains identical and a string cell without formulas in each workbook format.

consumer_assertions.result: Exact array string, string cell type, and no-formula assertions pass in source XLSX, re-saved ODS, and re-saved XLSX.
